title: Hogwarts Adventure
description: A Harry Potter-inspired 3D adventure: get sorted into a house, explore a candlelit castle, learn 8 spells, duel dark wizards, a troll and Dementors, and earn house points in six minigames (Quidditch, Potions, Duelling Club, wand drawing, Hippogriff flight and a Chocolate Frog chase). Host your world online and friends can join in. Keyboard, touch and controller support.
